text:
alex_dev: quick shift snapshot — current top things:
- Incident: embed-eviction spike in eu-west1 (P2). Started ~08:12 UTC, ~3% 5m error rate on embed reads.
- Regen latency bumped for long-tail requests in eu-west1.
- Autoscaler: small jitter after last policy tweak, not impacting majority of pods.

What I did: rolled back the kvproxy memory tweak that landed at 08:05 (reverted to v2.4). Put extra logging on eviction path. Noticed related GC churn on one host (node-eu-42).

Mitigations in place:
- rolled back kvproxy (stops the higher eviction rate) :white_check_mark:
- cordoned node-eu-42 and drained workloads small batch — moved regen workers to standby pool
- temporary lowering of eviction aggressiveness via config flag `cache.eviction.threshold=0.6`

Next steps / ask:
- Maya, can you continue watch for 30m & escalate to infra if evictions creep back?
- Jordan, can you look at the autoscaler logs for the jitter signature I pasted below?
- I'll keep the rollback and monitor token cost; planning to open an RFC for kvproxy memory defaults.

logs snippet I pulled (choppy):
```
2026-03-17T08:13:21Z WARN kvproxy evicting shard id=124 free=12MB used=88%
2026-03-17T08:13:22Z ERROR embed.read failed id=abcd1234 code=ENOTFOUND
2026-03-17T08:14:05Z INFO autoscaler scale_decision delta_cpu=0.02 pods=2->3
```

maya_oncall: on it, taking watch. I left a heartbeat ping in pagerduty. If eviction rate < 0.5% after 08:45 I'll mark as mitigated. Also pinging infra channel for node-eu-42 OOM pattern.

jordan_sre: looking at autoscaler logs — seeing a tiny surge of policy recalcs at 08:04-08:06 that lines up with the kvproxy change. Will post filtered logs. Possible fix: debounce policy window from 15s -> 30s for the short term.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: kvproxy v2.4 rollback -> success on cluster eu-west1 at 08:18 UTC. CI: all checks passed. :robot_face:

alex_dev: thx. Quick PR/ops notes: PR #4987 (autoscaler debounce) needs 1 more review. @taylor_pm tagging since this affects canary policy for dedicated tiers.

taylor_pm: saw PR, will review in next 20m. If debounce helps we can ship as canary to eu-west1 only. Will coordinate with release window.

maya_oncall: update @all — 08:36 UTC eviction rate down to 0.4%, regen p50 back to baseline, p95 still ~120ms above baseline (monitoring). Keeping watch for the next 20m.

alex_dev: handover: Maya takes next 30m watch. Jordan to queue autoscaler debounce PR if logs confirm. I will draft RFC for kvproxy defaults today. Anything else?

taylor_pm: noted. I'll approve PR if logs look consistent after debounce test.

jordan_sre: will post logs in 10m and link the PR.

maya_oncall: final note — added a short playbook entry under runbooks/embed-eviction with these mitigations and rollback steps. :memo:
